gloss: winning and losing, victory and defeat

definitions.gloss: winning and losing, victory and defeat, the outcome
definitions.explanation: The result or outcome of a competition, expressed as the combined concept of winning and losing. Often used when discussing whether outcomes matter, the nature of competition, or results in general.

examples.japanese: {勝|か}ち{負|ま}けは{気|き}にしない。
examples.english: I don't care about winning or losing.

examples.japanese: スポーツでは{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けがはっきりする。
examples.english: In sports, the outcome is clear-cut.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもに{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けだけにこだわらない{大切|たいせつ}さを{教|おし}えたい。
examples.english: I want to teach children the importance of not being fixated solely on winning and losing.

notes:
A compound of {勝|か}ち (winning) and {負|ま}け (losing), treating the two as a single concept. Often used in contexts discussing whether outcomes matter, or when talking about competition philosophy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けにこだわる (to be fixated on winning/losing)
・{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けを{決|き}める (to determine the outcome)
・{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けは{関係|かんけい}ない (winning or losing doesn't matter)
・{勝|か}ち{負|ま}けがつく (an outcome is decided)
